title: The Truman Show — Everyone Knows Truman Is Being Watched. So Why Doesn't Anyone Tell Him?
central_question: If millions of people know Truman is living inside a manufactured world, why does almost nobody try to help him escape?
core_thesis: Truman's entire life is controlled by a television production, but the audience watching him becomes part of the same system. The viewers care about Truman, but their entertainment depends on his lack of freedom. They can feel affection for someone while still benefiting from a system that exploits him.
